'''Ethin''' is a servant of Lord [[Algarin Pendaloan]] in [[Tear]].

==Appearance==
Ethin is a bony man with white hair and a creaky voice.

==Activities==
Ethin brings and announces [[Logain Ablar]] when he comes to Lord Algarin's manor to see [[Rand al'Thor]].{{ref/book|11|18}}
